title: Blue Oasis Downtown Nashville, Walk to Broadway
description:
Welcome to our home! A stylish 1 bedroom Luxury apartment centrally-located in downtown Nashville and walking distance to Broadway & all other local attractions.

We are: 
★ 0.2 miles from Music City Center
★ 0.4 miles from Bridgestone Arena
★ 0.4 miles from Country Music HOF
★ 0.7 miles from Broadway
★ 1.3 miles from Nissan Stadium
★ 6.8 miles from Nashville International Airport

STRP_2022059361

The space
This charming luxury apartment located on the 10th floor is packed with style, modern luxurious design, plenty to entertain and relax, and room for guests to enjoy.

From relaxing in our comfortable queen bed to having fun and lounging in our exquisite central pool to simply enjoying all of the amenities right outside including a gym, this warm and welcoming private luxury apartment has something for everyone to make your stay a memorable one!

★ LIVING AREA ★
Relax and unwind in the bright, open living space with doors that have almost floor-to-ceiling window inserts and a modern luxe design with comfort in mind. The TV comes loaded with streaming apps like Amazon Prime Video, Apple TV, Disney+, HBO Max, Hulu, YouTube and Netflix (You will be able to log into your own account) to keep everyone entertained.
✔ Luxe Lounge
✔ 50" Smart TV
✔ Modern Space Design

★ KITCHEN & DINING ★
The kitchen comes fully equipped with everything you would need to cook up all your favorite meals, from the built in microwave to the spacious fridge/freezer, to the oven and electric stove.
You’ll have access to quality cookware, dinnerware, and utensils along with a Keurig coffee maker to get your day started right and all the cooking essentials you would need right at your fingertips.
Eat together (or solo) at the elegant dining with seating which can also be a perfect game and lounge table.
✔ Stainless Steel Appliances - Fridge/Freezer, Microwave, Oven
✔ Keurig Coffee Maker
✔ Cookware, Dinnerware & Utensils
✔ Dining for four

★ BEDROOM & BATHROOM ★
Within the apartment, you’ll find a comfortable queen beds topped with soft, high quality Egyptian cotton sheets along with plenty of space for you to unpack and make yourself at home. The plush sofa converts into a queen size bed to accommodate for larger groups! This private luxury apartment comes with beautiful doors with huge window inserts that brighten the entire room and overlooks the outside.
There is a lavish full bathroom that come stocked with all the essentials for your stay along with soft fluffy towels so you don’t have to worry about a thing.
✔ Bedroom –  1 Queen Beds, Egyptian cotton sheets, Pillows, Plant Accents, Doors with open window inserts
✔ Livingroom – 1 Queen size sofa bed
✔ Luxurious Full Bathroom
✔ Soft Fluffy Towels
✔ Soap, Shampoo, and Body wash

★ OUTDOOR LIVING AND ACTIVITIES ★
On a beautiful day downtown Nashville, step out by the central pool where you can have fun, enjoy the fresh air or simply relax. Enjoy a drink or two outside by the patio or at the charming lounging area with a partner, friends, or family. If you are into health and fitness, this place offers a modern Gym! 
✔ Indoor & Outdoor workspace
✔ Commercial Fitness Center
✔ Pool
✔ Community Pool Table

So if you are looking for somewhere special for your next vacation or just a weekend away at the heart of Nashville all just minutes away from attractions like the Music City Center, Broadway, shopping malls and exquisite restaurants and bars, look no further than this modern, charming, luxurious suite that offers a thoughtful design packed with amenities for everyone to enjoy.

***** and MUCH MORE *****

Our mission is to make sure that your stay in our Glamorous getaway suite become an unforgettable and amazing experience.

★ FUN PLACES AND ATTRACTIONS NEARBY WITHIN 30 MINUTES FROM THE PROPERTY ★

- The Country Music Hall of Fame and Museum: This museum is located in downtown Nashville and is home to exhibits and collections showcasing the history and evolution of country music.

- The Frist Art Museum: This art museum, also located in downtown Nashville, features a wide range of rotating exhibits, including contemporary art, photography, and more.

- Cheekwood Estate & Gardens: This historic estate and botanical garden, located just 15 minutes from downtown Nashville, features 55 acres of gardens, art, and a historic mansion.

- Belle Meade Plantation: This historic plantation and winery, located just 15 minutes from downtown Nashville, offers tours of the mansion and grounds, as well as wine tastings and events.

- Radnor Lake State Park: This nature reserve, located just 20 minutes from downtown Nashville, offers hiking trails, wildlife viewing, and peaceful views of the lake.

- The Parthenon: This full-scale replica of the Parthenon in Athens, Greece, is located in Centennial Park in Nashville and features a permanent art collection.

- Adventure Science Center: This interactive science museum, located just 10 minutes from downtown Nashville, features exhibits and activities for all ages, including a planetarium.

- Nissan Stadium: Home to the Tennessee Titans NFL team, this stadium offers tours and hosts concerts and other events throughout the year.

- The Nashville Zoo: This zoo, located just 15 minutes from downtown Nashville, features a wide range of animals from around the world, as well as special events and programs.

- The Ryman Auditorium: This historic music venue, located in downtown Nashville, is known as the "Mother Church of Country Music" and offers tours and performances by a variety of artists.

Guest access
You are welcome to use the entire place. Please make yourself feel right at home!

Our keyless entry system provides for an easy self check in and gives your direct access to ALL amenities. This system also provides peace of mind and a safe & secure building.

Please also keep in mind that we have a ZERO tolerance policy on any violations of all short term rental ordinances and our house rules. No over occupancy - the occupancy listed on the agreement is the only occupancy allowed in the property. No additional guests allowed at any time.

Other things to note
Parking in the city can be expensive and it is first come, first serve. For $35/night, we have a designated parking space in our gated garage that you can use for your stay with us!

Need party decorations for special occasion? Message us and let us decorate for you!

Photo ID will be required to confirm booking.
